get.description: Return a lightweight liveness response for the API process.
Return the public adapter catalog derived from canonical valid registry entries. Registrations that are SUBMITTED, INVALID, or FETCH_FAILED do not appear here.
Return public adapter cards whose title matches the search term.
Return one public adapter. The response is metadata-light; fetch full Croissant metadata through the adapter metadata endpoint.

post.description: Record that the signed-in user endorses this adapter.

get.description: Return the full stored Croissant metadata document for one adapter.

post.description: Validate an inline Croissant adapter or dataset document without persisting it. Adapter validation includes the adapter document and each embedded dataset fragment. Validation failures return 200 with is_valid=false; malformed requests return 422.
Generate dataset Croissant metadata from a server-side input path. The backend writes to a temporary file, returns the generated metadata in the response, and validates by default.

Generate adapter Croissant metadata from existing dataset metadata files and/or generated embedded datasets. Paths are server-side paths visible to the backend process. The endpoint returns metadata without creating a registration.

Store one adapter repository as a tracked registration request. The repository may be a local path or remote URL and should contain a root-level croissant.jsonld file. Processing happens later through the process endpoint or a registry refresh.

get.description: Return active registration summary rows. This list is intentionally metadata-light; use the registration detail endpoint for processing details and metadata payloads.
Return whether a remote repository exposes root-level croissant.jsonld.
Return the event history recorded while submitting, processing, refreshing, or revalidating one registration.
Return one operator-facing registration detail record. This endpoint may include discovered metadata, metadata path, validation errors, and canonical uniqueness details.

post.description: Discover the submitted repository metadata, validate the adapter and embedded datasets, update registration status, and create or reuse a canonical registry entry when valid.
Reprocess one registration whose current status is INVALID or whose latest event is FETCH_FAILED.

get.description: Return maintainer/operator rows for active registrations, including public status and latest event type. The optional filters are strict; unsupported values return 422.
